# Matrix {#sec-matrixCoding}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}
Tableau matematika!

This is a direct of matrix in mathematics.
That is it contains one of the atomic element.
Same type of tirror with horizontal coordinate called row and vertical coordinate called column.

It must be a rectangle! and the size is called dimensions.
In its purest form, we can extract the element by they coordinate, in vector we have only the order, in matrix, we have two [row coordinate, colum coordinate].

But it is better used for mathematical computation and not for data storing --- dataframe is more convenient

In practice, a vector is just a "one dimensional" matrix

## Formal {.unnumbered}
Matrix in r is constructed using mat with these arguments.
You can give a vector and partition/ arrange them by row or column.

## Examples {.unnumbered}

mat[1]
mat[1,]
mat[,1]
mat[1,3]
mat[1, c(1,10)]
